items.title: 12.13.4 Uses and industrial applications (istemal aur industry mein kaam) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.13.4, printed pages 287-288.

blocks.text: Sulphuric acid ko 'chemicals ka badshah' (king of chemicals) kaha jata hai, aur kisi mulk mein is ka istemal us ki industrial progress (taraqqi) ka measure (paimana) hai.

items: Acid ka bara hissa fertilizers banane mein jata hai; aam taur par 77.67% acid calcium phosphate (Ca₃(PO₄)₂) wale phosphate rock ko galane (digest karne) mein istemal hota hai.
Ores se metals nikalne mein, jaise Cu, Ni, steel waghera.
Tel (oil) aur koyle ki refining, polymers, synthetic rubber aur plastic ki industry mein catalyst ke taur par.
Pulp aur kaghaz ki industry mein, aur pesticides, insecticides, herbicides, varnish, dyes, medicines (dawaiyan), sabun aur detergents ki preparation (tayyari) mein.
Explosives banane ke liye nitration mein, jaise trinitrotoluene (TNT), nitroglycerine, picric acid, nitrocellulose waghera.
Food ki industry mein cheeni, starch aur corn syrup banane mein.
Paint ki industry mein titanium dioxide (TiO₂) pigment banane mein.
Industry mein gases ko dry (khushk) karne mein.
Lead storage batteries mein 35.67% acid istemal hota hai.

blocks.text: Halanke yeh bohat si industries mein istemal hota hai, phir bhi aakhri product mein yeh bohat kam (rarely) hi hota hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain)
blocks.text: Sulphuric acid fluorapatite (Ca₅(PO₄)₃F) se single superphosphate Ca(H₂PO₄)₂ aur phosphoric acid (H₃PO₄) banane mein istemal hota hai. H₃PO₄ se aage double aur triple superphosphates aur ammonium phosphate bante hain. Sulphuric acid ammonia se react kar ke ammonium sulfate fertilizer bhi banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Sulphuric acid ke istemal ko industrial progress ka measure kyun samjha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Taqreeban har industry mein yeh kahin na kahin istemal hota hai: fertilizers, metals, kaghaz, plastic, dyes, explosives, food aur batteries. Is liye jis mulk mein jitni zyada industry, utna zyada sulphuric acid kharch hota hai, halanke aakhri product mein yeh bohat kam hota hai.

items: 'King of chemicals': sab se zyada fertilizers (phosphate rock, superphosphates, ammonium sulfate).
Metals nikalna, refining aur polymers mein catalyst, kaghaz, pesticides, dyes, dawaen, detergents, explosives (TNT), cheeni aur starch, TiO₂ pigment, gases khushk karna, lead batteries, lab reagent.
